standard-dialogue.npc: Can I bother you for a moment?
Do you ever think you'd rather have one of my larger friends to be your companion? I can't carry you like they can.

standard-dialogue.player: I'm actually glad to have you with me! You may even grow up to be giant one day. Maybe then you could carry me everywhere.

standard-dialogue.npc: Except towards volcanoes... We birds aren't so good in those conditions.
